title: Neural Bellman Operators
new_work: Exact evidence recovery, independent endpoint replay, corrected independent-reference mechanism postprocessing, instrumented deterministic scalar-reference replay, finite-observation theory and diagnostic, manuscript integration and preservation verification.

statistical_family.rule: Retain every original endpoint with its original allocation. New mechanism, reference and sensing calculations are explicitly descriptive diagnostics and add no confidence endpoints.

sensor_diagnostic.scope: Direct noisy observed-state feedback compared with protected innovation parent on shared fine Euler paths; no new continuous-time inference from simulated differences.

publication: One immutable integrated evidence commit, with two original generating sources identified separately and all raw files preserved. No historical fit is relabelled as a new R14 training run.
